meta_data.base_class: Analyze the internal social dynamics and personality distribution within a <professional group> group to identify behavioral interaction patterns - <professional group> refers to a population of individuals sharing the same profession or social role, whose group behavior can be studied through composition and interpersonal traits.

tool_template.name: analyze_<class>_dynamics
tool_template.description: Analyze the social dynamics and interactions within a <class> group based on personality traits and group size.

total.description: The total size of the <class> group.

extroverts.description: The number of extroverted members in the <class> group.

introverts.description: The number of introverted members in the <class> group.

average_age.description: The average age of the members in the <class> group.

gender_distribution.description: The gender distribution within the <class> group, represented as a percentage of male.

hierarchy_level_variance.description: Represents the degree of hierarchy variation within the <class> group, where higher values indicate greater inequality.

include_visualization.description: If true, the analysis output for the <class> group will include a visualization component, such as charts representing interaction patterns.
